deliverables: Allocate capital to builders expected to improve monthly active users, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
Require funded projects to track core KPIs: monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions.
Continue development of the DAO as an operational, on-chain, KPI-driven funding mechanism.
Disburse milestones from an independent multisig after administrator validation and confirmation.
request.recipient: Cardano Builder DAO, with an independent council/multisig administrator composed of dRep DAO members holding and disbursing funds before milestone-validated release to the DAO.
request.what: Treasury withdrawal to fund the Cardano Builder DAO as a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven funding mechanism for Cardano builders.

claims.claim: The proposal says the Cardano Builder DAO is a smart contract-governed funding mechanism intended to support projects advancing Cardano Vision 2030 through measurable KPIs including MAU, monthly on-chain transactions, and TVL.
The proposal says funded projects are required to track monthly active users, TVL, and on-chain transactions to align treasury funding with Cardano's 2030 KPI framework.
The proposal says the DAO has already distributed 11.1 million ADA across 34 proposals in two funding rounds.

The proposal says Round 1 included 38 voting members and 27 requesting members, funded 20 companies, had 83% governance participation, and distributed 5,541,335 ADA through a transparent smart contract-governed process.
The proposal says Round 2 added 18 new members, funded 14 companies, and reached 88% member participation after review, debate, temperature checks, and final voting.

The proposal says the DAO created and amended governing documents, elected a board, added third-party assurance, implemented merit-based proposal review, and executed treasury withdrawals on-chain with full transparency.

The proposal says official Cardano developer documentation describes the CB DAO as a smart contract-governed mechanism with more than 50 established Cardano projects participating in funding decisions and KPI tracking tied to on-chain activity, users, and TVL.

The proposal says an independent council including Cardano Yoda, Marco Grendel Moshi, and one additional unaffiliated active dRep will receive the treasury withdrawal, hold funds, and oversee milestone-based disbursement.

The proposal says ADA held by the administrator before disbursement will be kept in separate community-auditable accounts, will not be delegated to a stake pool, and will be delegated to the predefined abstain voting option.
The proposal says the CB DAO returned 354,790 ADA of unused funds to the Cardano Treasury after its first two governance rounds, with an AdaStat transaction URL provided.

summary: The anchor presents a 20,000,000 ADA treasury request for Cardano Builder DAO to continue and scale a smart contract-governed, KPI-driven builder funding mechanism, citing prior funding rounds, governance participation, KPI tracking, independent milestone administration, and a prior unused-funds return.
